Serve the LOGOS toolchain over the Model Context Protocol (stdio).

Speaks JSON-RPC 2.0, one JSON object per line: check with structured diagnostics, sandboxed deterministic runs, English→FOL, kernel-certified proofs, code emission, and optimization reports — plus the quickguide and docs guides as MCP resources. Made for AI agents; humans want the plain subcommands.

Usage: largo mcp [OPTIONS]

Options:
  -q, --quiet
          Suppress informational output (errors still print)

  -v, --verbose...
          Increase output verbosity (repeatable)

      --color <WHEN>
          When to use terminal colors

          Possible values:
          - auto:   Color when stdout/stderr is a terminal and `NO_COLOR` is unset
          - always: Always emit ANSI, even into pipes (CI logs, `less -R`)
          - never:  Never emit ANSI
          
          [default: auto]

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')

Examples:
  largo mcp
  claude mcp add logos -- largo mcp
